source_help: Rechecks the selected type and your permissions each run. Add a Content card to select one exact item.
provider_help: Uses a configured text provider. No provider runs when you save.
agent_help: Waits for this named external agent to pick up the reviewed work. A saved key does not mean the agent is connected.
schedule_help: Connect to one provider or agent. Enable separately after reviewing the destination and context.
no_connections: Connect a content selection, prompt or note to a provider or agent.
connection_error: This connection is invalid or already exists. Each schedule has one target.
consent: I reviewed this destination and the content being sent. Results are added as notes; nothing is published.
recurring_consent: I approve recurring runs with this type/count selection until I disable the schedule. New matching content may be included.
no_runs: No runs yet. Saving this board does not run anything.
uncertain: Delivery uncertain — review before trying again
sharing_help: Only the selected nodes are shared. Key scopes and current content permissions also apply.
run_grant: Request a run for human review
operations_error: The operation could not be confirmed. Refresh status before retrying a run.
save_first: Resolve the unsaved changes before running or changing access.
reload_result: Reload the board to show new result notes. Unsaved changes will require your confirmation.
run_confirmed: Run accepted. Check the run history for the actual outcome.
preset_help: Creates a new private board. Choose real content and a configured destination before running. Schedules start disabled.
preset_ready: Template added. Complete the highlighted selections, connect your inputs and review before running.
private_media: Private result — visible to this board owner
media_error: Media is unavailable. Check the run status.
run_stopped: Run stopped. Review configuration and provider status before requesting a new run.
cancel_run_help: Stop accepting a result for this run? This does not cancel work already sent to an external provider.
